acceptance.scope: Workstation geometry and assembly-blueprint review only

supersedes.rule: Workstation v1 5 x 4 footprint with 5 x 3 support plane
supersedes.reason: Owner rejected the oversized geometry and required one compact 3 x 2 tabletop footprint.

camera.surfaceFurnitureComposition: top-down support plane plus independent straight-elevation rear, base, and foreground parts

canonicalDesk.generationRule: The complete tabletop and floor reservation are one 3 x 2 plan footprint. Legs, drawers, aprons, and vertical faces are render-height parts and never add footprint rows. Adjacent desks touch edge-to-edge without stretching the bitmap.

monitor.placement: centered on the edge farthest from the seated actor

keyboard.placement: centered on the row nearest the seated actor

acceptanceExamples.adjacency: Three-tile desk modules and the two 3 x 2 rows may touch edges but never overlap.
acceptanceExamples.depthSorting: The greater sortPivot.y draws later; visual height never changes logical depth.
acceptanceExamples.occlusion: Foreground parts may cover the lower body while the actor head-safe region remains visible.
acceptanceExamples.overflow: Rear, base, and foreground pixels may cross the footprint only through declared render bounds and offsets.
acceptanceExamples.rejectedDesk: Any 5 x 4 or 5 x 3 workstation rule, any extra employee-edge footprint row, or any desk bitmap stretched to fill logical cells.
